column2: This is the city of $$リベイラ$$! Though folks from other towns call it the $$背徳の街$$!
What are you lowly white-$$羽$$ doing, wandering around town without permission?!
Oh—my apologies! You're that $$神官$$'s $$奴隷$$!
This city has a great many churches.
The greatest of them all is the $$太陽の神殿$$, but...
Its former $$大神官$$, Lord $$ヨハネ$$, apparently made some blunder and was sent to prison!
The $$大神官$$ of the $$太陽の神殿$$, Lord $$ユダ$$, is the ruler of this city!
Lord $$ユダ$$ is consumed by $$嫉妬$$ and kills people at the drop of a hat...
$$嫉妬$$ is all well and good, but I don't want to die, so...
the old ruler, Lord $$ヨハネ$$, is still far more popular...
The temples in this city are said to hold religious ruins created in that famous
war of the gods!
Honestly, though, nobody knows whether it's true...
They say this city has some incredible armor left behind by demons...
Even if it was made by demons,
surely you'd lose out by not using anything with real power, right?!
Of course, I got this way of thinking from the great former ruler, Lord $$ヨハネ$$!
Do you know what $$邪道騎士$$ are...?
Apparently,
they obtained enormous power by putting on armor left behind by the gods...
Looks like $$神官$$ soldiers are gathering at the $$太陽の神殿$$!
Even $$神官魔法$$ differs according to a priest's specialty...
So they say each $$神官$$ can use different magic depending on their specialty!
But you can't tell which from the outside unless they actually attack you!
They say the $$封印の間$$ in that church hides a vast supply of weapons used by the white demons...
Though rumor has it most of those weapons are cursed...
Welco...
Welco...
What d'you want, you white-$$羽$$?!
Running an errand? What do you want?
Every one of our wares is top quality and worth the price!
Welco...
It never ends~
